quiz.title: Class 12 Maths Chapter-wise Test
quiz.intro: Eight mixed questions drawn from calculus, matrices and determinants, vectors and 3D, probability and linear programming. Answer each, then press Check my score.

questions.q: The value of ∫₀<sup>π/2</sup> cos x dx is:
questions.explanation: The antiderivative of cos x is sin x, so the value is sin(π/2) − sin 0 = 1 − 0 = 1.

questions.q: If A is a 3×3 invertible matrix with |A| = 5, then |A⁻¹| equals:
questions.explanation: For an invertible matrix, |A⁻¹| = 1/|A|. Here that is 1/5.

questions.q: The area of the parallelogram with adjacent sides a = i + j and b = j + k is:
questions.explanation: a × b = (1, −1, 1), so the area is its magnitude √(1 + 1 + 1) = √3.

questions.q: The distance between the parallel planes 2x − y + 2z = 5 and 2x − y + 2z = 11 is:
A box has 3 red and 2 blue balls. Two are drawn without replacement. The probability both are red is:
questions.explanation: P(both red) = (3/5) × (2/4) = 6/20 = 3/10, since the first red leaves 2 red out of 4 balls.

questions.q: The corner points of a feasible region are (0,0), (4,0), (3,3) and (0,5). The maximum of Z = 2x + 3y is:
questions.explanation: Evaluate Z at each corner: 0, 8, 15, 15. The maximum value is 15, attained at (3,3) and (0,5).

questions.q: The function f(x) = 2x³ − 9x² + 12x has a local maximum at:
questions.explanation: f′(x) = 6(x − 1)(x − 2) is zero at x = 1 and x = 2. Since f″(1) = −6 < 0, x = 1 gives the local maximum.

questions.q: For a 3×3 matrix A with |A| = 3, the value of |adj A| is:
questions.explanation: For an n×n matrix, |adj A| = |A|<sup>n−1</sup>. With n = 3, that is 3² = 9.

faq.q: Which chapters do Class 12 Maths chapter-wise tests usually cover?
faq.a: They span the full CBSE syllabus — relations and functions, inverse trig, matrices and determinants, continuity and differentiability, applications of derivatives, integrals, differential equations, vectors, three-dimensional geometry, linear programming and probability.

faq.q: How should I use chapter-wise tests during revision?
faq.a: Finish a chapter, take its test the same week while the ideas are fresh, and log every wrong answer. Revisit those exact question types after two or three days rather than re-reading the whole chapter.

faq.q: Which Class 12 Maths chapters carry the most marks in the board exam?
faq.a: Calculus — integrals, applications of derivatives and differential equations — is the largest block, followed by vectors and 3D geometry together, then matrices and determinants. Probability and linear programming are smaller but scoring.

faq.q: How many questions should one chapter test have?
faq.a: A focused chapter test of 8 to 12 questions is enough for a single sitting. Mix one-mark objective questions with a few longer problems so you practise both speed and full-solution writing.
